items.title: Network Performance & Optimization

items.title: Redis Lua Scripting: Atomic Batches, Distributed Locks & The Roundtrip Latency Law
items.description: Deep dive into Redis Lua script execution: solving data corruption between batch imports and point updates, production-grade distributed lock release, Redis TIME as a monotonic cluster clock, cooperative pod handovers, and the network RTT math.
